value.message: This account already has 4 posted journal line(s), so its type can only change to another balance sheet, debit-normal account (same statement, same normal balance). Moving it across the Balance Sheet / Income Statement boundary would silently restate posted balances and retained earnings. Create a new account and post a reclassifying journal entry to move the balance instead.
